second_read.note: Independent second read of a QMBL-added row. Hamiltonian H = J1 sum_<i,j> S_i S_j + J2 sum_<<i,j>> S_i S_j with spin-1/2 operators (v1 Eq. 4, v2 Eq. 6), 'square lattice with periodic boundary conditions and N = 36, 64 and 100 spins 1/2'; Table I is per site in S.S units with J1 = 1 (the paper's own 6x6 ED column and its quoted Sandvik QMC cells fix it). Size, boundary and J2 agree with the instance; 'ViT' is a variational NQS, so bound_type variational is right; method_as_published 'ViT' is the column header; peer_reviewed false is right (no journal reference on the abs page, 2026-09-29); primary (column '(this work)'). Kind of number: the authors' extended data (2026-09-28) states that Table I lists the best of ten checkpoints (every 150 of 1500 epochs), each a 4096-sample estimate; no error bar is printed, so sigma stays null (RULES.md 6). energy_variance 0.288 = sigma^2 x 16 x 100 with sigma^2 = 1.800e-4 = (<H^2>-<H>^2)/N per spin (S.S units), authors' extended data row '0.10 -0.631365 2 0.18 -0.631354 2 0.17 -0.631330 0.57 0.16', column group 'the best epochs, 4096 samples; Table I'; V-score N Var/E^2 = 4.5156e-4 recomputes. Best checkpoint is an earlier epoch; the final (1500th) epoch gives -0.631354 on 4096 samples and -0.631330 (error 5.70e-6) on 102,400 samples, 3.50e-5 per site above the Table I value.

error_metrics.note: Best of ten checkpoints (one every 150 epochs of 1500), each measured on 4096 samples: the state and sample set behind the energy Table I prints. Var(H)/N in S.S units, stored as a Pauli total (x 16 N). The source also gives an error epsilon = 2e-5 per site; it equals sqrt(sigma^2/(N x 4096)), the standard error without autocorrelation, so it is used only for the agreement check and not attached as sigma (RULES.md 6; Tristan, 2026-09-28).
